title: Ing alang patugut a kakampi keng pamanyubuk ning gintu
intro: King anino ning metung a dakilang propeta, metung a kaladwa ning masanting a pamagsalita at kasalpantayanan ing mepili ban sumaup king metung a maragul a misyun. Ing pigura ayni tinalakad yang matatag inyang ding dakal a tau mewala la, manaral laban keng metung a malino a pamaglabag a magbanta keng mismung core ning monotheism. Inyang mibalik ya ing propeta ban saksian ing pamaglapse da ring tau, ing depensa na niting pigura e ya king kasalanan nune king katungkulan at takut king pamikawani. Ninu ining tapat a talasuyu nang Allah?
clues: pinili naku ning Allah para keng sagradung katungkulan kayabe ning aliwa, at ing kanakung obra metung yang suporta at pamagproklama.
Mirinan kung kalinawan king pamagsalita, at tinuki ku king metung a tubud ban arapan ing metung a mayupayang mapang-api.
keng metung a kritikal a pamaglakbe, ing tubud minukiat yang magdili-dili keng bunduk, likuan na kung magbante kareng tau.
King karelang pangawala, ginawa lang gintung larawan ding tau, at pekisabi ku karela king manatili lang tapat, oneng e ra tinggap ing payu ku.
Inyang mibalik ya ing tubud, mitmu yang mua at lungkut, mebihag ku, dapot pepaliwanag ku king mebigu ku at tatakut kung mika pamipatepate karela.
Aku ing propetang tinalakad siping nang Musa, ing kapatad ku, midake king pusan na at menatili kung matatag laban king pamanyamba karing idolo.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Ding tau sasamban de ing gintung biserung baka agyang atin lang babala
Inugse da ku ding tau king milalablab a api
Melaklak naku ning metung a maragul a asan
Miyugse ku king kanakung siudad uli na ning pamanaral ku
trial.answer: Ding tau sasamban de ing gintung biserung baka agyang atin lang babala

outcome.label: Kelabasan
options: Me-exonerate ku at tinuglung ku keng misyun kung propeta
Miparusan ku uli na ning kasalanan da ring tau
Midinan kung bayung bangsa ban gabayan
gewa da kung pamuntuk ning metung a kayarian
outcome.answer: Me-exonerate ku at tinuglung ku keng misyun kung propeta

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant. (25:35)
